description: The Discover it card (••••8369) is managed through Capital One now (Discover was acquired by Capital One). The card-walkthrough workflow card inventory and the chase-card-offers-discover skill both still direct to discover.com, which is no longer the correct portal. Portal mapping and any changed benefit/category structure are unknown.
correction: Skip the Discover portal. Route Discover card activity through Capital One. The portal URL, benefit structure, and rotating-category mechanics need to be re-mapped before the card can be walked again.
root_cause: Issuer acquisition changed the servicing portal; the workflow and skill were never updated.
